description: This file contains functions for generating and managing test specifications and coverage views within the TestLink test management system. It includes functions to build hierarchical structures of test suites and test cases, filter and prune test data based on various criteria, and extract linked version information for test cases. The functions facilitate the creation of detailed test plan views, coverage reports, and custom field integrations, supporting complex filtering, tree traversal, and data aggregation for test management and reporting purposes.

classes.name: testcase
classes.description: TestLink's test case manager class, responsible for managing test case data, versions, and tree hierarchy operations.

classes.name: tlPlatform
classes.description: Platform manager class, handles platform data associated with test cases and test plans.

classes.name: testplan
classes.description: Test plan management class, involved in retrieving linked test case versions and filtering test case data within test plans.

classes.name: testproject
classes.description: Test project class, used for managing projects, their test cases, and related filters such as keywords and platforms.

methods.name: gen_spec_view
methods.description: Generates a hierarchical view of the test specification starting from a given node, with filtering and pruning options.

methods.name: gen_coverage_view
methods.description: Creates a coverage report view for test cases linked to a specific test plan or project, with filtering and tree pruning features.

methods.name: getFilteredLinkedVersions
methods.description: Retrieves linked test case versions filtered by keyword, platform, and other criteria, optionally scoped within test suites.

methods.name: getFilteredSpecView
methods.description: Fetches a filtered test specification view based on criteria like keywords, test cases, and execution types, adhering to logical AND/OR filters.

methods.name: getFilteredSpecViewFlat
methods.description: Flattens the hierarchical test spec into a list for easier processing or reporting, with support for filters and options.

methods.name: getTestSpecFromNode
methods.description: Extracts a subtree of test cases and test suites starting from a specific node, applying various filters.

methods.name: buildSkeleton
methods.description: Constructs a hierarchical structure representing test suites and test cases from raw test spec data.

methods.name: buildSkeletonFlat
methods.description: Creates a flat list structure of test suites and test cases for simplified processing.

methods.name: addLinkedVersionsInfo
methods.description: Enriches test cases with linked version information, statuses, and execution details.

methods.name: removeEmptyTestSuites
methods.description: Prunes test suites that contain no test cases or linked items, optionally considering linked version status.

methods.name: removeEmptyBranches
methods.description: Removes branches in the test suite tree that have no test cases, to optimize the view.

methods.name: addCustomFieldsToView
methods.description: Integrates custom fields data into test suite and test case views based on platforms and linked versions.
